column2: Every asset must match the approved Gainlands paint-overs (Card Game Art / Paintovers / PAINTOVER-GAINLANDS-HUB, -MILL-FIELDS, -PROVING-GROUNDS, -SKY-GARDEN, -SWOLYMPUS-TRAILHEAD): bright midday sun, sun-bleached timber, red brick and brass, red-gold banners, sunflowers and hay. Painted, not pixel: clean bold shapes, soft cel-shaded painting, rich harmonious colour, matching PAINTOVER-TOWN.png. Palette #F2C14E, #D9483B, #8BC34A, #F7EBD3, #7A5230, #5FA8D3. No text or letters anywhere.

Seamless, tileable, hand-painted game texture, viewed perfectly straight-on (orthographic, no perspective). Flat, even, neutral lighting: no cast shadows or directional highlights (the game lights it). Evenly distributed detail. Edges must match so it tiles. No text. Square, 1024x1024.

A single hand-painted element, viewed straight-on (orthographic) or top-down for decals, centered, filling most of the canvas, with a fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). Soft painted shading but no cast shadows outside the object and no strong directional light. Crisp clean edges. No text. Size per row.

A single hand-painted tree or plant, full and lush, seen from a low camera slightly above (about 25 degrees down), painterly clumped-foliage shapes, warm sunlight from the upper left with soft painted shading inside the foliage, base/trunk at the bottom center as if growing from the ground. Fully transparent background (PNG). No ground, no cast shadow, no text. Vertical 2:3, 1024x1536.

Six related items (doors, windows, signs or banners) in a 3x2 grid with clear transparent gaps between them so each can be sliced apart automatically, each item viewed straight-on, centered in its cell, consistent scale across the sheet. Fully transparent background (PNG). No text. 2048x1365.

Concept art of one hero landmark, 3/4 view from the front-left, on a plain pale background, a person (1.7 m) standing beside it for scale, clear silhouette, every material readable (wood, brick, stone, brass, cloth). Reference only: Claude rebuilds it as a 3D model textured with the kit. 1536x1024.

A wide painted backdrop strip seen from far away: soft, hazy, no hard objects in the middle of the horizon, transparent sky above the skyline (PNG with alpha) so it can stand as a ring behind the zone, or a full sky panorama for the SKY rows. 2048x1024.
